data.description: discovered-from:WL-0MUBVH8QG0020H9L. WL-0MUBVH8QG0020H9L AC6 asked to update skill/audit/SKILL.md with the derived child-coverage semantics, but that file is NOT in the ContextHub repository (the audit skill is installed globally from the separate SorraAgents repo and cannot be edited from a ContextHub worktree). In-repo docs were added instead (packages/herdr/README.md; docs/dev/downtime-dispatcher.md; code comments in icons.ts, worklist.ts, fetcher.ts, index.ts, downtime-worker.ts). Follow-up in SorraAgents: document that a completed/in_review child is covered by its parent's fresh audit (derived at read time, nothing persisted), that covered children render a dimmed parent symbol, and that children are never audit-dispatched independently (root-only + client-side parentId guard).
data.title: Document derived child-audit coverage in the global audit skill (SorraAgents)
